transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic and Nscale may finalize another 45 billion dollar compute deal, Still open per TechCrunch, amid investor concerns over artificial intelligence spending.
The Department of Homeland Security has banned DeepSeek artificial intelligence from U.S. government systems, Confirmed by The Hill, over data security fears.
Huawei and DeepSeek collaborate to optimize artificial intelligence chips, Confirmed per 디지털데일리, reducing reliance on another company's ecosystem.
ChatGPT alerted parents in just 5 percent of teen safety conversations, Reported by EdTech Innovation Hub, mostly for suicidal thoughts.
Germany and Nvidia have signed a deal to boost industrial artificial intelligence, Reported by IT Journal, via open models and ecosystem development.
